integrity_statement: Universal proof based solely on incidence axioms; executable finite-field checks corroborate eight orders but do not certify untested or non-Desarguesian planes.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct parallel lines in an arbitrary existing finite affine plane; no complete support polynomial, no assertion for arbitrary/intersecting pairs, higher dimensions, or nonexisting orders. Historical priority not independently settled.
title: Exact static and online dimensions of double-parallel-line concepts in finite affine planes
